name: Proxibarbal
summary: Proxibarbital (Ipronal) is a barbiturate derivative synthesized in 1956 in Poland by Bogusław Bobrański. It has anti-anxiety and sedative properties and is, in contrast to most barbiturates, almost without hypnotic action. It was used as a sedative and anti-anxiety drug. It was also used in the treatment of migraine headaches in a similar manner to butalbital.

summaryZh: 丙羥比妥，或譯丙氧巴比妥，是一種巴比妥類衍生物，於1956年首次合成。它具有抗焦慮特性，與大多數巴比妥類藥物相比，幾乎沒有催眠作用。它也以與布他比妥類似的方式用於治療偏頭痛。哇洛凡在體內異構化為丙羥比妥。

sideEffects.en: Little is recorded about it specifically. Barbiturates in general can cause drowsiness, dizziness and poor coordination, can lead to dependence with dangerous withdrawal, and can be fatal in overdose.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它本身的紀錄不多。巴比妥類整體而言可能引起嗜睡、頭暈和協調變差，可能導致依賴並伴隨危險的戒斷症狀，過量時可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它本身的纪录不多。巴比妥类整体而言可能引起嗜睡、头晕和协调制差，可能导致依赖并伴随危险的戒断症状，过量时可能致命。

fact.en: Proxibarbal belongs to the barbiturate family, which is built on barbituric acid, first made by the German chemist Adolf von Baeyer in 1864.
fact.zh: 丙羥比妥屬於巴比妥類，這類藥物以巴比妥酸為基礎，而巴比妥酸是德國化學家 Adolf von Baeyer 在 1864 年首次合成的。
fact.zhHans: 丙羟比妥属于巴比妥类，这类药物以巴比妥酸为基础，而巴比妥酸是德国化学家 Adolf von Baeyer 在 1864 年首次合成的。
